m.s: Slice {chorizo} into thin rounds. Fry in a large dry frying pan over medium heat for 4 to 5 minutes until crispy and the oil runs red. Lift out with a slotted spoon and leave the oil in the pan.

Cut {chk_thigh} into bite-size pieces and season with salt and pepper. Turn the heat up to medium-high and brown the chicken in the chorizo oil for 4 to 5 minutes until golden. Set aside with the chorizo.

Turn the heat down to medium. Add sliced {onion} and {capsicum} and cook for 8 minutes until soft. Add crushed {garlic}, {smokedpaprika}, {chilliflakes} and {tompaste} and stir for 2 minutes until it darkens.

Add {tintom} and the chicken, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring now and then, until the sauce is thick and the chicken is cooked through. While it simmers, put a big pot of well-salted water on to boil.
Stir in {cream} and {spinach} until the spinach wilts, then add the chorizo back. Taste and season.

Cook {pasta} until al dente. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain. Toss the pasta through the sauce with a splash of the water so it coats every piece. Serve with grated {parm} and chopped {parsley}.

l: Keep a mug of pasta water to loosen the sauce when reheating. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF pasta in its own pot. Check the chorizo label; most are GF but not all.
